_README: Copy this file to jobs/<name>.json and run `npm run pdf:job <name>`.
It prints out/NamNguyen_CV_2026_<name>.pdf and changes nothing in src/ or docs/.
Only jobs/example.json is committed. Everything else in jobs/ is gitignored,
because this repo is public and a file named jobs/tv4.json tells the world
target  replaces the line under your name. The one thing that genuinely
changes per job. Keep it short: it fits one line at print width up
to about 85 characters, and wrapping it costs 16px of the 17px of
swap    exact find-and-replace over the rendered text, for a skill note or
a bullet you want to lead with differently. A find that matches
NOTHING fails the run and writes no file, so a typo cannot produce
a PDF that looks tailored and is not.
label   what the harness prints so you can see which job it just made.
url     the posting, so the file still explains itself in six months.
label: Example Co. - Senior Front-End Engineer
swap: Performance: code splitting, compositor-only animation, profiling
